original: ねえ、カノンノはどう思う？
traducao: Hey, Kanonno, what do you think?

original: あたし、最近ほんとカイウスの\n考えてる事がわからなくて
traducao: Lately I really don't understand\nwhat Caius is thinking.

original: う〜ん、色んな人がいるから\nそんなに深く考え込まなくても\n大丈夫な気もするけど……
traducao: Hmm, there are all kinds of people,\nso you don't need to think about it\nso deeply, but......

original: でも、怖いじゃない？\n夜中にふと目が覚めたら
traducao: Still, isn't it terrifying?\nIf you suddenly wake up at night...

original: 部屋で無心になってブーメランを\n投げてる人がいるのよ！
traducao: and someone is in the room mindlessly\nthrowing a boomerang around!

original: 何だよ、その話だったら\nちゃんと説明しただろ？
traducao: What, I already properly explained\nthat to you, didn't I?!

original: 理由なんてない、ただ何となく\nそうしたい気分になっただけだ\n……ですって？
traducao: 'There is no reason,\nI just somehow felt like it'\n......is what you said, right?!

original: そんなの！　\n余計怖くなるじゃない！
traducao: Saying that\nonly makes it even creepier!

original: 何でだよ！？
traducao: Why would it?!

original: ほんとに理由はないんだから\nしょうがないだろ
traducao: There really isn't any reason,\nso what else can I say?!

original: 何となく手に取ると\nそのまま……
traducao: I just happened to pick it up,\nand before I knew it......

original: つい、投げ続けちゃうんだよ！
traducao: I just ended up keeping on throwing it!

original: だったら、投げた後に我に返って\n自分で自分にひくのやめなさいよね！
traducao: Then stop snapping back to your senses\nand creeping yourself out!

original: もう、ほんっとそういうところ\n子どもなんだから
traducao: Geez, you really are such a child\nin moments like that!

original: それとこれとは関係ないだろ！？
traducao: That has nothing to do with this?!

original: あーりーまーすー！
traducao: Yeees it doooes!

original: 二人とも、本当に仲がいいんだなぁ
traducao: You two really get along so well.

original: どうしよう……困ったなぁ
traducao: What should I do...... I'm in trouble.

original: どうしたの？
traducao: What's wrong?

original: あ、カイル
traducao: Ah, Kyle.

original: あのね……洗濯物が飛ばされて\n海に落ちちゃって……
traducao: You see... Some laundry was blown away\nand fell into the sea......

original: ルーティのシーツなんだけど……
traducao: And it's Rutee's bedsheet......

original: ええっ、母さ……ルーティさんの！？
traducao: Whaaat, Mom'... er, Rutee-san's?!

original: 大変だ、すぐ取りに行かなくちゃ！\n夜眠れなくなっちゃうよ！！
traducao: Oh no, I must go get it right away!\nShe won't be able to sleep tonight!!

original: えっ……でも
大丈夫。\n心配しないで
traducao: It's fine.\nDon't worry.

original: これでも泳ぎは得意なんだ！
traducao: I'm actually quite good at swimming!

original: あれっ。\n二人とも、何してるんだ？
traducao: Huh?\nWhat are you two doing?

original: ロイド、シング！　\nグッドタイミングだよ！\n実はかくかくしかじかで……
traducao: Lloyd, Shing!\nGreat timing!\nThe truth is, so on and so forth......

original: 大変だ！\nすぐに探しに行かなくちゃ！
traducao: That's terrible!\nWe've gotta search for it right now!

original: 今ならまだ、そんなに遠くまで\n流されてないんじゃないか？
traducao: Right now, it probably hasn't drifted\nthat far yet, right?

original: オレもそう思う。\nところで二人とも……泳ぎの方は？
traducao: I think so too.\nBy the way, how are you at swimming?

original: バッチリだよ！
traducao: I'm all set!

original: 問題ないぜ！
traducao: No problem at all!

original: えぇぇ！？\nちょっと、泳ぐって、飛び込むの？
traducao: Eeeek?!\nWait, swimming? You're diving in?!

original: というか、そんな事しなくても\n他の人から借りられれば……
traducao: I mean, even without doing that,\nif we could just borrow another...

original: 大丈夫だよ。\nオレ達、これでも\n体力には自信あるからさ！
traducao: It'll be fine.\nWe've got plenty of stamina to spare,\nafter all!

original: そうそう。\n木の船に乗ったつもりで\nどーんと待っててくれよな
traducao: Yeah, yeah.\nJust sit back like you're on a wooden ship\nand leave it to us!

original: よし。\nじゃあみんなで\nガンドコダッシュだ！
traducao: Alright!\nThen let's all do a\nGandoko Dash!

original: おー！
traducao: Yeah!

original: ……って、ちょっとぉ……\nなんなの、その勢いとノリ……
traducao: ......Wait, hey......\nWhat is with this reckless momentum......

original: カノンノは一人部屋なんだね。\n寂しくないの？
traducao: You have your own room, Kanonno.\nDon't you get lonely?

original: 寂しいとかはないけど……。\nルームメイトは、欲しい……かな
traducao: It's not really lonely, but...\nI think I'd kind of like a roommate.

original: そうよね。\n女の子一人じゃ\n夜とか少し怖いもの
traducao: Right?\nFor a girl on her own,\nthe night can be a little scary.

original: でも、ルームメイトはちゃんと\n見定めなくちゃダメよ
traducao: Still, you have to choose\nyour roommate very carefully.

original: お互いの生活リズムが合って、\n協力してやっていける相手じゃないと
traducao: Someone whose daily rhythm matches yours,\nand who you can cooperate with.

original: ルビアにとっての\nカイウスみたいなものだね
traducao: Like Caius is for you,\nRubia, right?

original: 冗談でしょ！\nカイウスなんてダメよ！　\n全然ダメ！
traducao: You have to be joking!\nCaius is terrible!\nCompletely hopeless!

original: 寝相は悪いし、いびきはうるさいし\nゴミの日にゴミ出すの忘れるし\nすっごい手がかかるんだから！
traducao: He tosses in his sleep, snores loudly,\nforgets trash day, and is just\nsuch an enormous handful!

original: ふふ……でも、楽しそう。\nルビアの顔にもそう書いてあるよ
traducao: Fufu... But you look happy.\nIt's written all over your face, Rubia.

original: そ、そんな事ないわよぅ！
traducao: T-That's totally not true!

original: ルームメイトか……いいなぁ。\n私も、誰かにお願いしてみようかなぁ
traducao: A roommate... That sounds nice.\nMaybe I should ask someone too.

original: そういえば、ルビアはどうして\nギルドにやって来たんだ？
traducao: Come to think of it, Rubia,\nwhy did you come to the guild?

original: 確か、結成時の初期メンバーだと聞いたが
traducao: I heard you were a founding member.

original: そっか。\nウィルさんにはまだ\n話した事なかったのよね
traducao: Oh, right.\nI haven't told you yet, have I,\nWill-san?

original: ……実は、故郷で色々あって\n何が正しくて何が正しくないのか\nちょっとわからなくなっちゃったの
traducao: ......A lot happened back home,\nand I lost sight of what was right\nand what was wrong.

original: でも、みんなが安心して暮らす為に\nギルドを立ち上げてお手伝いをするっていう\nアンジュさんの考えは正しいと思ったわ
traducao: Yet I felt Ange-san was right about\nstarting a guild to help everyone\nlive in peace and safety.

original: だから、出来る事をしながら\nあたしはあたしで\n色々考えてみようと思ったの
traducao: So while doing what I can,\nI wanted to think things through\nin my own way.

original: そうか。\n……答えは見つかりそうか？
traducao: I see.\n......Do you think you'll find an answer?

original: 正直、まだまだ考え中
traducao: Honestly, I'm still figuring it out.

original: でも、そんな簡単に答えがわかったら\nつまらないじゃない？
traducao: Still, wouldn't it be boring\nif the answer came that easily?

original: 時間がかかってもいいの。\nあたしは、本当の事が知りたい
traducao: It's fine if it takes time.\nI want to know the truth.

original: 焦ってウソの情報に踊らされるより\nそっちの方がずっとマシよ
traducao: That's much better than rushing\nand being led astray by false rumors.

original: 気が強いとは思っていたが\nこれは予想以上だな
traducao: I knew you were strong-willed,\nbut this exceeds my expectations.

original: しっかりしたお嬢さんだ
traducao: You are a very sensible young lady.

original: うふふ、当然よ
traducao: Ufufu, of course!

original: あたしはカイウスのお守りも\nしてるんですからね♪
traducao: After all, I have to keep an eye on\nCaius too, you know~

original: 感謝の気持ちを忘れるのって\nとっても悲しい事じゃない？
traducao: Isn't it terribly sad\nwhen people forget how to be grateful?

original: いきなりどうした。\n随分実感のこもった言い方だな
traducao: What brought that on all of a sudden?\nYou speak with deep feeling.

original: それはそうよ。\nあたしだって、神官見習いなんですもの
traducao: Well, of course.\nI am an apprentice priestess, after all.

original: これでも色々、人の気持ちに対して\n思うところがあったりするの
traducao: Even I have my own thoughts\nabout the human heart.

original: そうだな……この時勢だ
traducao: Indeed...... In times like these,

original: 端的な救いを求める者ばかりが増え\n人は、他者への気遣いや感謝の思いを\n日ごとに忘れていっている
traducao: people seek simplistic salvation,\nforgetting consideration and gratitude\nfor others by the day.

original: 慈愛の心を説く教会関係者として\n心穏やかではいられまい
traducao: As someone preaching the church's love,\nit must be hard to maintain peace of mind.

original: それもそうだけど……。\nあたしが腹を立てているのは\nカイウスのこと！
traducao: Well, that too, but......\nWhat I'm actually mad about\nis Caius!

original: カイウスったら最近、あたしが洗濯物を\n片付けてあげたりしても、\nお礼の言葉一つ言わないの
traducao: Even when I fold his laundry,\nCaius doesn't say a single word\nof thanks lately!

original: 昔はそんなんじゃなかったのに\nいつから感謝の気持ちを\n忘れてしまったのかしら
traducao: He wasn't like that in the past.\nI wonder when he forgot\nhow to show gratitude?

original: ああ、思い出したら\n余計に腹が立ってきちゃった！
traducao: Ah, just thinking about it\nis making me even angrier!

original: それは、感謝の気持ちとは\nまた別の問題があるんじゃないか……？
traducao: Might there not be another issue\nat play besides gratitude......?

original: （……おい。\n　何で今日に限って、偉い人ばっかり\n　集まってるんだよ……）
traducao: (...Hey.\nWhy are all the important people gathered\nhere today, of all days...?)

original: （もう、そんな事\n　あたしが知るわけないでしょ？）
traducao: (Geez, how would I know\nsomething like that?)

original: （だけど……困ったわ。\n　出て行きづらいわね……）
traducao: (Still... this is bad.\nIt's hard to leave now...)

original: （今日のメニューは\n　オレの好物のハンバーグ定食なのに！）
traducao: (And today's menu has my favorite,\nthe hamburger steak set!)

original: （あたしだって、日替わりメニューの\n　特製タマゴスープが飲みたいわよ。\n　でも、出直しましょう）
traducao: (I want the daily special egg soup too,\nyou know.\nBut let's come back later.)

original: （何でだよ？\n　オレは絶対、定食を食うんだ！）
traducao: (Why?!\nI'm definitely eating that set meal!)

original: （馬鹿、わからないの？）
traducao: (Dummy, don't you understand?)

original: （あの人達が、ああやって集まって\n　普通にご飯を食べられるのは、\n　このギルドの中だけなのよ）
traducao: (Those people being able to gather\nand eat a normal meal together...\nIt's only possible in this guild.)

original: （そうか……外だともっと\n　堅苦しい理由とか、\n　何か色々なくちゃ、会えないんだよな）
traducao: (I see... Outside, they can't meet\nwithout stiff formalities\nand all kinds of reasons...)

original: （そういうこと。\n　ほら、わかったら行くわよ？）
traducao: (Exactly.\nNow that you get it, let's go, okay?)

original: （だけどよ……）
traducao: (But still......)

original: （もう、駄々こねないの。\n　ハンバーグだったら、次の当番の時\n　あたしが特別に作ってあげるから）
traducao: (Geez, stop whining.\nIf you want hamburger steak, I'll make\nsome special for you on my next shift.)

original: （本当か？　やったぜ！！）
traducao: (Really?! All right!!)

original: （ふぅ……もう、カイウスったら。\n　本当に子どもなんだから……）
traducao: (Sigh... Geez, Caius.\nYou really are a kid at heart......)

original: チェルっちとビアっちって、似てるよね〜
traducao: Chel-chel and Rubie look so alike~

original: そうですか？
traducao: Is that so?

original: 確かに、髪の色は近いかも……
traducao: Well, our hair colors are close...

original: でも、どちらかというと私はピンクで\nルビアさんは赤ですよね
traducao: Though mine is more pink,\nwhile Rubia-san's is red.

original: ぶっぶー、全然外れ
traducao: Bzzzt! Totally wrong!

original: そこよ、そこ！　\nそこ以外絶対、ない！！
traducao: Right there, right there!\nThere is nowhere else, absolutely!!

original: そこって……
traducao: Right there...?

original: どこですか？
traducao: Where is it?

original: だから、そのかぼちゃパンツ！\nソックリじゃん！
traducao: I mean those pumpkin pants!\nThey're totally identical!

original: ルビア　　：かぼちゃパンツじゃないわよ！！！\nチェルシー：かぼちゃパンツじゃないです！！！
traducao: Rubia: They aren't pumpkin pants!!!\nChelsea: They are not pumpkin pants!!!

original: ウィルさんって、お洋服着てても\n筋肉隆々なのがわかりますよね
traducao: Will-san, even with your clothes on,\nyou can tell you're really muscular.

original: 隆々ではないさ。\n必要な分だけ鍛えているだけだ
traducao: I wouldn't say 'very muscular.'\nI only train as much as necessary.

original: でも、あんなに\n大きなハンマーを振り回せるのは\nその筋肉があるからですよ
traducao: Still, swinging such a big hammer\naround like that is all thanks\nto those muscles of yours!

original: 気が付いたら、こうなっていた……、\nというのが正しいのかもしれないが
traducao: Though it might be more accurate to say\nI ended up like this before I knew it...

original: コ、コングマンさん？\n大丈夫ですか？
traducao: K-Kongman-san?\nAre you alright?

original: 俺様の前で筋肉を自慢するとは、\nいい度胸だな、ウィル？
traducao: Bragging about muscles before Great Me...\nYou've got some nerve, Will!

original: 誰も自慢などしていない
traducao: No one was bragging.

original: こうなったら勝負だ！\nどっちの筋肉が美しいか決めるぞ！
traducao: In that case, it's a showdown!\nWe'll decide whose muscles are superior!

original: ふっ！
traducao: Hmph!
Mmh!!

original: はっ！！！
traducao: Hah!!!

original: さあ、お前の番だぞウィル。\nそして、ルビアが勝敗を決めてくれ！
traducao: Come on, your turn, Will!\nAnd Rubia, you judge the winner!

original: え？　\nえ？　\nあたしですか？
traducao: Eh?\nEh?\nMe?!

original: コングマン、オレの負けだ。\nお前の筋肉の方がすごい
traducao: Kongman, I concede defeat.\nYour muscles are far more impressive.

original: 負けを認めるなんて潔いなぁ！\nよしよし！！
traducao: Admitting defeat so gracefully!\nGood, good!!

original: フィリアさ〜ん、勝ちましたよ〜∀
traducao: Philia-san, I won~~!

original: ありがとうございます……
traducao: Thank you very much......

original: いや、気にする事はない……
traducao: No, think nothing of it......

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.
